You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=set(c for c in set(x for r in g for x in r))
    # find line color: color whose cells form a full straight line (all in one row or col, contiguous)
    linec=None
    for c in bg:
        rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][cc]==c for cc in range(w))]
        cols=[c_ for c_ in range(w) if all(g[rr][c_]==c for rr in range(h))]
        if len(rows)==1 or len(cols)==1:
            linec=c; break
    L=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][cc]==linec for cc in range(w))]
    assert len(L)==1
    L=L[0]
    objs=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=linec and g[r][c]!=bg]
    # blobs via flood fill of non-background colors
    seen=set(); blobs=[]
    for r,c,v in objs:
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        comp={(r,c)}; q=deque([(r,c)])
        while q:
                    x,y=q.popleft()
                    for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nx,ny=x+dx,y+dy
                        if 0<=nx<h and 0<=ny<w and g[nx][ny]!=linec and (nx,ny) not in seen:
                            comp.add((nx,ny)); q.append((nx,ny))
        seen|=comp; blobs.append(comp)
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for blob in blobs:
        rs=[r for r,_ in blob]; cs=[c for _,c in blob]
        dr=(L>max(rs)); # move toward line
        if dr==True:
            shift=L-max(rs)-1
            # clamp: must stay in grid
            ok=True
            if max(r+shift for r,_ in blob)>h-1: ok=False
            newcells=[(r+shift,c) for r,c in blob]
            for r,c in blob: out[r][c]=bg
            for r,c in newcells: out[r][c]=g[orig_r[orig_c]][orig_c] if False else None
    return out

import os,re,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def solve(I, wall_col=None, wall_row=None, grav_left=True):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    P=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=7]
    # wall = marker line cells (color 2)
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    def blocked(r,c):
        if not(0<=r<H and 0<=c<W): return True
        return out[r][c]!=7 and out[r][c]!=2 and out[r][c]!=8
    while True:
        moved=False
        # sort particles bottom-first so lower settle first
        P.sort(key=lambda p:-p[0])
        for r,c,v in P:
            if grav_left:
                nr,nc=r,c-1
                diag=(r+1,c-1) if grav_left else None
                if not blocked(nr,nc) and (diag is None or not blocked(diag[0],diag[1])):
                    out[r][c]=7; out[nr][nc]=v; P[sorted(P,key=lambda p:(p[0],p[1]))].__setitem__(P.index((r,c)),(nr,nc,v))
                    moved=True; break
            else:
                nr,nc=r,c+1
                if not blocked(nr,nc) and not blocked(nr,nc+1):
                    out[r][c]=7; out[nr][nc]=v; P[P.index((r,c))]=(nr,nc,v); moved=True; break
        if not moved: break
    # paint 8-line: vertical col at far side of final pos, or horizontal row
    return out

# gravity left, wall col12; test pair3
o=solve(G['Demo pair 3 input'], wall_col=12)
print(o==G['Demo pair 3 output'])

import os,re,numpy as np,json
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); O=I.copy()
    se=[r for r,row in enumerate(I) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]==2][0]
    bg=int(np.bincount(I.flat).argmax())
    pat={(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in zip(*np.where((I!=bg)&(I!=2)))}
    rs=[r for r,c in pat]; cs=[c for r,c in pat]
    tr,br=min(rs),max(rs); tc,bc=min(cs),max(cs)
    H,W=br-tr+1,bc-tc+1
    # travel direction: move pattern toward separator
    travel = -1 if br < se else 1
    T=tr
    while True:
        nT=T+travel
        adj = (nT==se-1 and br<se) or (nT+H-1==se+1 and br>se)
        if adj: break
        T=nT
        if T<0 or T+H>I.shape[0]: break
    # clear old pattern footprint
    for r in range(tr,br+1):
        for c in range(tc,bc+1):
            if I[r][c]!=2: O[r][c]=bg
    # paint translated pattern within its bbox columns
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=I[T+i][tc+j]
            if v!=2: O[T+i][tc+j]=v
    # marker row: full-width row at the NEW pattern's extreme END FAR FROM separator
    if br<se: mr=T   # new top is far end
    else: mr=T+H-1
    for c in range(O.shape[1]): O[mr][c]=8
    return O
for n in [5,6,7]:
    P=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])
    print(n,'match:',np.array_equal(P,np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])))

import numpy as np
def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I)
    se=[r for r,row in enumerate(I) if len(set(row))==1][0]
    bg=int(np.bincount(I.flat).argmax())
    mask=(I!=bg)&(I!=2)
    rs,c_=np.where(mask); pat={(int(r),int(c)) for r,c in zip(rs,c_)}
    tr,br=min(rs),max(rs); tc,bc=min(c_),max(c_)
    H,W=br-tr+1,bc-tc+1
    travel=-1 if br<se else 1
    T=tr
    while True:
        nT=T+travel
        adj=((nT==se-1 and br<se) or (nT+H-1==se+1 and br>se))
        if adj: break
        T=nT
    O=I.copy()
    for r in range(tr,br+1):
        for c in range(tc,bc+1):
            if O[r][c]!=2: O[r][c]=bg
    P=I[T:T+H, tc:bc+1]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=P[i][j]
            if v!=2: O[T+i][tc+j]=v
    mr = T if br<se else T+H-1
    for c in range(O.shape[1]): O[mr][c]=8
    return O
for n in [5,6,7]:
    print(n, np.array_equal(solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']), np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])))

        s=dd-proj-1

        for (r,c) in pts: out[r+s][c]=g[r][c]
        for r in range(H): out[r][far]=8
    return out

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    div=None
    for r in range(H):
        if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=1:
            div=('h',r,g[r][0]); break
    else:
        for c in range(W):
            if len(set(g[r][c] for r in range(H)))==1 and g[0][c]!=1:
                div=('v',c,g[0][c]); break
    vert,dd,dv=div
    pts={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (1,dv)}
    if not pts: return out
    # direction of move: object slides along the divider's axis toward it until face touches
    if vert:
        proj=max(c for _,c in pts)   # rightmost col of object; assume left-of-divider case
        gap = dd - proj - 1
        if gap <= 0: gap = 0
        far_col = min(c for _,c in pts) - 1   # column of line beyond far side? verify below
        s = gap
        newpts={(r,c+s) for r,c in pts}
        # line: one step beyond settled near face (farthest from divider side)
        line_col = min(c for _,c in newpts)-1 if gap>0 else min(c for _,c in pts)-1
        line_col=min(line_col, max(0,min(c for _,c in newpts)-1))
        for r in range(H): out[line_col][r]=8
    else:
        proj=max(r for r,_ in pts)
        gap = dd - proj - 1
        if gap<=0: gap=0
        newpts={(r+gap,c) for r,c in pts}
        line_r = min(r for r,_ in newpts)-1 if gap>0 else min(r for r,_ in pts)-1
        for c2 in range(W): out[line_r][c2]=8
    # erase old, paint new
    for r,c in pts: out[r][c]=1
    for r,c in newpts: out[r][c]=g[r][c]
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 7','Demo pair 8']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
